name: 学習の進行と終了
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: ONE Lighthouse catalog component LH05-0001, 学習の進行と終了, isolated flat UI design candidate.
Primary request: Redesign the existing compact learning progress strip in the official Lighthouse design system while preserving the exact supplied mock layout, information, progress amount, controls and visible state. Output one clean horizontal component on pure white, no device frame, no explanatory labels and no unrelated UI.
Input images: Image 1 is OUR SAVED MOCK and authoritative Japanese layout/content for this candidate (390 by 60 logical px). Image 2 is the ORIGINAL SOURCE SCREEN, inspect ONLY its top learning progress/close region for structure; do not reproduce the other lesson content. Image 3 is the OWNER-APPROVED BUS STYLE REFERENCE, for smooth forest-green gradients and restrained depth only; never copy bus content.
Composition: A compact horizontal strip, close X at left, rounded progress track in the center, small Japanese remaining-count text at right. Retain close icon at x~28, track x64 to294, y22 with height16, progress filled126 of230 units (~55%), and the text at x310. Preserve the mock's exact visible text “残り 4”. This is saved mock content, not a newly inferred original metric.
Style: pure white #FFFFFF canvas and component surface. Consistent slate #526173 close glyph. Light neutral gray track #E4E4E4. Completed progress smoothly graduates from deep forest #174C36 through #1F6444 to #2D8F5E, very gentle top-edge light and minimal soft depth. No broad mint fill, no neon, plastic gloss, giant shadow or decorative container.
Typography: preserve Meiryo Regular 12px with 16px line height and zero tracking for “残り 4”, scaled proportionally in the raster; do not make it bold or add a heading. Counter may use #1F6444. Maintain baseline and readable Japanese glyphs.
Accent decision: Original lime progress indicates completion; adapt that functional accent to the official forest-green gradient. Original purple energy/infinity lives in the source; the saved Japanese mock replaces it with “残り 4”; keep this mock state and disclose that provenance outside the image, do not add a purple battery or another counter.
Constraints: EXACTLY one X control, one progress track filled ~55%, one text label “残り 4”. Preserve horizontal compactness and relative geometry. No extra buttons, title, percent, numbers, logos, illustration, watermark, status bar or bus/map content. Render crisp high fidelity UI; keep all content fully visible. Prefer a very wide tight component crop matching its 390:60 ratio; if the output canvas is less wide, keep the component centered with only pure-white outer padding rather than stretching its logical geometry.
reviewNotes: Agent inspected original screenshot, original crop comparison, mock and output. Original lime completion adapted to forest gradient; purple energy replaced by existing mock content 残り 4, a recorded provenance mismatch. Output retains X, about55percent progress and correct Japanese text, white background, slate icon, smooth gradient. Raster has white outer padding due3:1 output; exact Meiryo metrics not proven. Candidate visual review only, no owner approval, native editability or app implementation.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
